column3: “the oak” renders “the great tree”; “it ended at” renders “its extremities were.”
“proceeded beyond them” renders “went out from them”; “the edge of the sword” renders “the mouth of the sword,” and “father” renders “ancestor.”
“In accordance with the command of” renders “on the mouth of.”
“the heads of the households” renders “the heads of the fathers”; “distributed” renders “gave as a possession.”
